effects.name: They Do
effects.description: Three figures arrive at the base and take up positions. They do not move while you look at them. They do not leave.

effects.name: Nightmare: Fall
effects.description: Dr. Kel is put to sleep where he stands. The dream starts very high and ends very low. Try not to look down. Or up.

effects.name: Flesh Rain
effects.description: It rains. It is not water. The forecast did not mention this.

effects.name: Official Email
effects.description: The inbox pings. Official business. Very official. Do not ignore official business.

effects.name: Break Server
effects.description: A satellite server goes dark. Someone has to walk out there. Alone. At night, probably.

effects.name: Become Nightmare
effects.description: An insomniac arrives, hunting. It does not knock. It does not stop. WARNING: Not all dreams can be awoken from.
effects.unavailableReason: Cet effet est désactivé dans la version du module récupérée.

effects.name: Kerfur Cosplay
effects.description: The cat robot puts on a new costume. It arrives with a dead battery - the base's power pays for it.
effects.unavailableReason: Cet effet est désactivé dans la version du module récupérée.

effects.name: Nightmare: Wendigo
effects.description: Dr. Kel is put to sleep where he stands. Something with antlers is waiting in the dream. Hope he runs fast.

effects.name: Crushing Exhaustion
effects.description: A wave of tiredness hits Dr. Kel like a truck. The bed starts sounding very reasonable.

effects.name: Email Arrives
effects.description: The inbox pings. The sender is the viewer. The subject line is a warning.

effects.name: Maintenance Notice
effects.description: The station reports a fault. The station has no such fault. The station is lying. Or is it?

effects.name: Pale Wisp
effects.description: One pale light drifts in the trees. Usually harmless. Usually.

effects.name: Mannequin Delivery
effects.description: A mannequin arrives at the base. Nobody brought it. Do not move it. Do not touch it.

effects.name: Fill with
effects.description: Cardboard boxes manifest around Dr. Kel. So many boxes. Where did they come from? Where will they go?

effects.name: Thought Appears
effects.description: Dr. Kel thinks something. It is not his thought. It knows that.

effects.name: Second Wind
effects.description: Dr. Kel suddenly feels wide awake. Whatever needed sleep can wait.

effects.name: Full Belly
effects.description: A full belly, courtesy of the void. Best not to ask what was in it.

effects.name: Wake Up
effects.description: Dr. Kel is ripped out of sleep early, heart pounding. Rude, honestly.

effects.name: Shove
effects.description: An invisible shoulder checks Dr. Kel to the floor. Nothing is there. Something is there.

effects.name: Daily Task
effects.description: The daily task email arrives. The tasks are wrong. The points are real. Probably.

effects.name: Insomniac
effects.description: Something that never sleeps has taken an interest in the one who watches the sky.

effects.name: Meta Paranoia
effects.description: A system message arrives. It looks exactly like the game's own. It is not the game's own.

effects.name: Disable Controls
effects.description: Dr. Kel's hands stop listening. The keyboard is right there. It does nothing.

effects.name: Nightmare: Mannequins
effects.description: Dr. Kel is put to sleep where he stands. A crowd of standing figures is waiting in the dream.

effects.name: You Are
effects.description: An Ariral shadows Dr. Kel's every step. It keeps a polite distance. Mostly.

effects.name: Force Open
effects.description: The nearest door opens on its own. The latch disagrees. The latch loses.

effects.name: Emergency Charge
effects.description: The battery bank surges back to full. Whatever was watching will have to wait.

effects.name: Points Grant
effects.description: Extra points arrive in Dr. Kel's account. Spend them before the sky notices.

effects.name: Red Sky
effects.description: The sky blushes a color it should not be. Nothing is wrong. Everything is fine.

effects.name: Power Drain
effects.description: The base's battery collapses. Lights dim, the terminal struggles, and the save machine goes quiet.

effects.name: Mannequin Appears
effects.description: One mannequin is standing somewhere out there on the map. It is facing the base.

effects.name: Eyes Are
effects.description: Eyes open in the dark around Dr. Kel. Look at them and they are gone. They are patient.

effects.name: Lights Out
effects.description: Every lamp in the base dies at once. The dark recovers them eventually. The dark outside is very patient.

effects.name: Base Lockdown
effects.description: Every alarm lamp goes red and every door slams shut. The base is a box. The box is closed. Nothing gets in. Or out.

effects.name: Starve
effects.description: Dr. Kel's stomach knots itself into a fist. The fridge is suddenly very far away.
